final:
shuffled(xs: List[int], seed: int) -> List[int] =
  post out.len() == xs.len()
  ex shuffled([], 7) == []
  ex shuffled([5], 3) == [5]
  var ys: List[int] = []
  for x in xs
    ys.append(x)
  var state = seed % 2147483648
  var i = ys.len() - 1
  while i > 0
    state = (state * 1103515245 + 12345) % 2147483648
    let j = state % (i + 1)
    let a = ys[i]
    let b = ys[j]
    ys[i] = b
    ys[j] = a
    i -= 1
  ys
